from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class JudgmentDocument(BaseModel):
    """Extracted metadata for a single judgment document summary."""
    title: str = Field(description="The title or identifier of the judgment document (e.g., '判决文书 1', '行政再审裁定书')")
    cause_of_action: str = Field(description="The specific cause of action (案由) explicitly stated in the document content")
    legal_domain: str = Field(description="The broad legal domain category identified (e.g., '民事', '行政')")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    documents: list[JudgmentDocument]
